verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer portal invites users to 'Try our MCP servers', and its marketing site says it connects RingCentral to LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude, so first-party official MCP servers are claimed. The evidence is only headline-level, with no detail on what the server does or how to connect an agent. Missing for 10: setup/connection documentation, exposed tool list and scopes, authentication model for agent connections, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP servers work.
